title: Senior Backend Developer (Mobile APIs)
text:
Demo Co. Oak is a scale-up building education apps. We are looking for a senior-level Backend Developer (Mobile APIs) to join our mobile team. Work is two office days a week in Fennick.

Our stack: kotlin, python, go. You will work closely with design and product, review code with the team and own the release process.

A small, senior team. You will mentor less experienced colleagues.
